_comment: Copy to home_devices.json and edit. That file is gitignored. Devices are named explicitly on purpose: guessing which of four lights you meant is how a voice assistant switches off the wrong room. `type` must be one of light, lamp, fan, plug, thermostat, lock, speaker, tv, blind -- anything else is ignored rather than guessed at. `target` is the backend identifier: a Home Assistant entity id (light.kitchen) or a Hue light name/id.
